gloss: to offer, to make an offering

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {供|そな}えていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to offer, to make an offering (to gods, ancestors, the deceased)
definitions.explanation: To present food, flowers, or other items as a religious or memorial offering, typically placing them at an altar, grave, or shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仏壇|ぶつだん}→仏壇：07116_butsudan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{供|そな}える。
examples.english: Offer flowers at the Buddhist altar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{墓|はか}→墓：03549_haka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{線香|せんこう}→線香：09995_senkou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{供|そな}えた。
examples.english: I offered incense and fruit at the grave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧、⟦{神棚|かみだな}→神棚：13740_kamidana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{供|そな}える⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日課|にっか}→日課：00317_nikka⟧になっている。
examples.english: It has become my daily routine to offer water and rice at the household Shinto altar every morning.

notes:
An ichidan verb. Not to be confused with the homophones ⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧ (to prepare, equip) or ⟦{具|そな}える→具える：02469_sonaeru⟧ (to possess, be endowed with), which use different kanji and have different meanings. The particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ marks the place or entity receiving the offering, while ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ marks the item being offered.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仏壇|ぶつだん}→仏壇：07116_butsudan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{供|そな}える (offer at the Buddhist altar)
- ⟦{墓|はか}→墓：03549_haka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{供|そな}える (offer at a grave)
- ⟦{神棚|かみだな}→神棚：13740_kamidana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{供|そな}える (offer at the household shrine)
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{供|そな}える (offer flowers)
- ⟦お{供|そな}え{物|もの}→お供え物：15307_osonaemono⟧ (offering, oblation)
